name: Pemba

routes.outcome: Official municipal page loaded and exposed a Leaflet map backed by a static bairro.js GeoJSON of 13 neighborhood boundaries. These are neighborhood polygons, not cadastral parcels, and contain no parcel IDs; not retained.
Current municipal JavaScript/configuration inspected. It contains only neighborhood boundary GeoJSON and public basemap tile URLs; no parcel or cadastral API request was present.

Official municipal IPRA page describes urban property tax, cadastral/property-matrix concepts and local municipal administration. General procedure/tax evidence only; no parcel endpoint or safe parcel geometry.
Official Agência Nacional de Desenvolvimento Geo-Espacial landing page identifies MOZGIS, metadata and spatial-data coordination. National agency evidence, not a Pemba-local parcel response.
Redirect page led to the official Rede Nacional SIG portal at https://dev.mozgis.gov.mz/portal/apps/sites/#/rede-nacional-sig-1.
Public ArcGIS catalog search returned total=0; no Pemba item.
Public ArcGIS catalog returned cadastral services for Vilankulo and Matola among results, but no Pemba service. Unrelated city services were not queried or retained.
Public ArcGIS Server directory loaded. The Data folder listed cadastral services for Matola and Vilankulo, but no Pemba/Cabo Delgado cadastral service.
Official Registos e Notariado Predial entry point discovered; it is a registry service entry point, not an anonymous parcel geometry API. No login or private route was used.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Pemba municipal bairro.js and public MOZGIS ArcGIS REST catalog were inspected.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No Pemba parcel response observed. The municipal neighborhood GeoJSON is longitude/latitude order, but it is not parcel data.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed; no Pemba parcel response obtained.

qualification.reason: Local municipal map/procedure evidence and national GIS infrastructure are documented, but no anonymous Pemba parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-12.9814805675136, 40.5312008662354] was preserved and not shifted.
A zero catalog result and absence of a Pemba item are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The municipal neighborhood map is not a cadastral parcel layer and was not retained as a parcel sample.
MOZGIS cadastral services found for Vilankulo/Matola are unrelated to Pemba and were not used as evidence of Pemba coverage.
No exact-point parcel query was completed because no Pemba parcel endpoint was exposed.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not imply source integration/admission; runtime readiness remains held.
uncertainty: Pemba may have offline, restricted, unpublished, or separately hosted cadastral records. Anonymous endpoint reachability, citywide coverage, schema, CRS, native identity, and update cadence remain unverified.
